title: fix(app-shell,components,console): the three remaining select placeholders read their locale key, not a hard-coded English "Select…" (objectui#11252)
body:
Fixes #11252
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The last three product selects that fell back to a hard-coded English `Select…` now read a locale key. No key was added and no dependency edge was added. The en text is unchanged at all three.

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`: an `enum` driver-config property with no value (the named producer is the Turso driver's optional `mode`) shows `t('engine.form.selectEllipsis', locale)` from Studio's own table, with `locale` from `useMetadataLocale()`. This is the word `SchemaForm`'s enum selects and `InspectorComboField` already show. The page imports `t` from `../i18n.js`, inside the `metadata-admin/` scope that `check:i18n-keys` classifies as the local table.
- `packages/components/src/custom/config-field-renderer.tsx`: the select arm's `field.placeholder ?? 'Select…'` is now `field.placeholder ?? t('common.select')`, through a `createSafeTranslation` defaults map (`common.select` set to `Select…`). This is the path the sibling `config-panel-renderer.tsx` uses for its footer: a published primitive with provider-less consumers. The hook sits above the `visibleWhen` early return. An author-supplied `placeholder` still wins, verbatim.
- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx`: the closed select's placeholder is `t('common.select', { defaultValue: 'Select…' })`, with `t` from `useObjectTranslation()`. This is the shape PR objectui#11250 used for `ScreenView`. It is also the console's documented idiom for app screens: `SettingsView`'s objectui#4024 comment records `useObjectTranslation` rather than `createSafeTranslation` for this directory. It is safe the same way: a provider-less mount answers the inline en default, never the raw key. `@object-ui/console` already declares `@object-ui/i18n`.
- `.changeset/11252-select-placeholders-i18n.md`: patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/console`.

## Pins

- One per site, each under `zh-CN` and `en`. Each asserts the key's identity: what the bound instance or the Studio table answers. A guard proves the zh answer is neither the en word nor the raw key. Each also has a CONTROL case, where a set value or a declared default renders instead of the placeholder.
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.selectPlaceholderLocale-11252.test.tsx`. It drives the real page against a faked authenticated fetch that serves a Turso-shaped catalog: `url`, plus an optional `mode` enum with no default. It clicks "New datasource" and reads the `mode` trigger.
  - `packages/components/src/__tests__/config-field-select-placeholder-i18n-11252.test.tsx`. This one also pins that an author-supplied placeholder still wins under zh-CN.
  - `packages/components/src/__tests__/config-field-select-placeholder-no-provider-11252.test.tsx` is the provider-less leg of the defaults map. It is its own file because `createI18n` registers a module-global instance that outlives `cleanup()`, the convention `config-panel-footer-no-provider-4750.test.tsx` already follows.
  - `apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.selectPlaceholderLocale-11252.test.tsx`.
- The enumeration pin: `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/select-placeholder-literal-11252.test.ts`.
  - It walks `packages/` and `apps/`, skipping tests, and parses only files that contain `Select` followed by an ellipsis (the U+2026 glyph or three full stops).
  - It classifies each string, template and JSX-text token with the TypeScript AST. Comments are trivia, so prose is never read as code.
  - Allowed positions: a locale pack row, a row under a dotted translation key, and the `defaultValue` of a translation call's options object. Anything else is an offender.
  - Lit control: each offender shape is planted in memory and must be found by the same classifier. The shapes are a JSX attribute, `??` and `||` fallbacks, JSX text, a `placeholder:` property (ASCII spelling), a template, and a pack-shaped row outside the packs. The allowed shapes and comments must not be flagged.
  - Population control: the tree scan must see a pack row, a table row and an inline default.

## Measurements (the PM's mechanism assumptions, re-measured at `7d074baae`)

1. **Confirmed.** Hard-coded `Select…` sits at exactly the three sites: the datasource page's enum `SelectValue`, `ConfigFieldRenderer`'s select fallback, and `SettingsField`'s closed select. Every other occurrence in product source is a translation-table row, `ScreenView`'s inline default, or a comment. The enumeration pin now re-derives this; no count is copied here.
2. **Confirmed.** `common.select` is defined in all ten built-in packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh). `engine.form.selectEllipsis` has an en row and a zh row in Studio's table, and `check:i18n-designer-parity` is green.
3. The dispatch's test lead `packages/components/src/custom/` holds no test files. The component's pins sit where the package keeps its config-panel pins, `packages/components/src/__tests__/`.

## Tests (final head `88a1f2d52`)

- Targeted union, run on `88a1f2d52` with `pnpm exec vitest run` (repo root, verbose): `Test Files 34 passed (34)`, `Tests 629 passed (629)`. It covered:
  - the datasource directory;
  - `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/`, which includes `spec-symbol-parity`, a reader of the page;
  - `scripts/__tests__/spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265.test.ts`;
  - `apps/console/src/pages/settings/`;
  - the five components `config-panel` / `config-field` pins;
  - plugin-dashboard's four `ConfigPanel*` suites, the only in-tree mounts of `ConfigFieldRenderer` besides `ConfigPanelRenderer`.
- The five new files alone: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 16 passed (16)`.
- Ablations, each through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. In every case the anchor hit 1→0, the blob moved, and the restore was proven (`blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty). The pins resolve their subjects through `src/` (vitest alias and relative imports), so no `dist/` leg applies.
  - A1: the datasource literal restored. `2 failed | 14 passed (16)`: the datasource zh case and the enumeration pin's "finds no offender", which named that file.
  - A2: the `ConfigFieldRenderer` literal restored. `2 failed | 14 passed`: the components zh case and the enumeration pin.
  - A3: the `SettingsField` literal restored. `2 failed | 14 passed`: the settings zh case and the enumeration pin.
  - A4: the `common.select` row deleted from the new defaults map. `1 failed | 15 passed`: only the provider-less leg.
  - Gate reach: changing the `SettingsField` inline default makes `check:i18n-keys` exit 1 with `[default-value-drift] common.select` on `SettingsField.tsx`. Changing the new defaults row makes it exit 1 with `[factory-default-drift] common.select (FIELD_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS)`. The gate reads both new call sites.
- Build and type-check. `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (29 packages) passed. So did app-shell plus the five remaining plugins of `@object-ui/console^...`. Then `pnpm --filter PKG type-check` exited 0 for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`. Each config's resolved file list contains the new test files: app-shell and components through `tsconfig.test.json`, console through `tsconfig.json`.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check-changeset-presence` (8 source files of 3 released packages, 1 changeset).
- `eslint` on the 8 changed ts/tsx files, with the repo config the package `lint` scripts use: exit 0, 0 errors. The 9 warnings all sit on lines this branch did not add.
- The changeset is markdown, so `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` was run (exit 0), and so was the root `scripts/__tests__/` suite on `88a1f2d52`: `177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, `Tests 5371 passed | 2 skipped`.
- Declared narrowing: the whole `packages/components/` and `packages/app-shell/` suites were not run locally. They are CI's. Each changed product file's in-tree importers were enumerated with `git grep`, and their suites are in the targeted union above:
  - the datasource page is imported only by its `register.ts`;
  - `ConfigFieldRenderer` only by `ConfigPanelRenderer`;
  - `SettingsField` only by `SettingsView`.

## Acceptance notes

These were observed and not filed. None has a measured public door or a named producer beyond this card. No carrier is known for any of them (承接者：无).

- `DatasourceResourcePage` carries other English copy: the driver select's "Choose a driver", the schema-mode labels, the status chips and the toasts. That is a page-level family, recorded as the precedent PR did. This card closes only the `Select…` family.
- The console's `useSettingsLabel` exposes a `fieldPlaceholder` helper that no arm of `SettingsField` calls, and the console's settings `Specifier` type declares no `placeholder`. This is dead code, not a contract gap.
- Studio's zh word for this slot (`engine.form.selectEllipsis`) differs from the zh pack's `common.select`. Each surface reads its own existing key, per the triage direction.
